text: **Hint 1:** Consider the properties of the ordinary least squares (OLS) regression model, especially when it includes an intercept term. How does the inclusion of an intercept affect the relationship between the mean of the fitted values and the mean of the observed values?\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the role of mean-centering in linear regression. How does mean-centering the data affect the intercept term and the overall fit of the model? Does it change the relationship between the means of the fitted and observed values?
